title: AxisPlugin
description: A plugin for managing a server, specifically roles, commands and places
body:
### Plugin for server managment
## Usage:
- **/afk** -> sets your status to afk, so that the server can’t kick you for inactivity, unless you move/interact with anything
- **/role**
  - **/role create [roleName] [roleColor]** -> creates a role with a specified name and color
  - **/role assign [playerName] [roleName]** -> assigns a specified role to a specified player
- **/allowcommand (or /acmd) [roleName] [commandName]** -> allows a role to use a command, bypassing vanila restrictions
- **/disallowcommand (or /dcmd) [roleName] [commandName]** -> disallows a role to use a command, bypassing vanila restrictions
- **/allowlist (or /alist)** -> send a message in chat, only visible to a player, that used the command, showing the list of all roles and their (dis)allowed commands
- **/placeset [placeName]** -> sets a place to teleport to
- **/place [placeName]** -> teleports player to a specified place
- **/placeremove (or /placer) [placeName]** -> allows user to delete a place after a confirmation
